title: Ramp header
description: A two-tier top bar that stays pinned: a near-black announcement strip with an underlined link and a close button, then a white 62px nav with a wordmark, chevroned menu links, a quiet sign-in link and an acid-lime and a near-black button. Phones get a square grey menu button that opens a full-width panel.
notes: sticks to the top of the page (position: sticky), so it pushes the hero down instead of covering it
the announcement strip forces the theme's dark colours with the dark class
JavaScript only dismisses the announcement; the phone menu is a native <details>
